claim: External MS MHC fine-mapping literature reports multiple statistically independent HLA and non-HLA effects within the MHC region.
future_grounding_route: Use as segregated MHC-complexity context; any MS-comparator colocalization claim still requires project-level locus-specific fine-mapping and QTL grounding.

relationship_note: The source independently supports the general premise that MHC association is multi-signal rather than a single simple shared association.

source.citation: Patsopoulos et al. Fine-Mapping the Genetic Association of the Major Histocompatibility Complex in Multiple Sclerosis: HLA and Non-HLA Effects. PLoS Genetics. 2013.
source.label: PLOS Genetics MS MHC fine-mapping study
